_comment: All references are local files; run_seedance.py uploads them to fal storage at submit time (cached by content hash in out/upload-cache.json). No external hosting needed.

start_frame.source: Crop (left region) of official-open-and-folded.png studio shot; person-free. fal/ByteDance rejects images containing real-person likenesses.

end_frame.source: Crop (right inset) of official-open-and-folded.png studio shot; person-free.

start_frame_with_person.source: UNUSABLE as Seedance input (real-person likeness, content_policy_violation). Kept for provenance.

end_frame_with_person.source: UNUSABLE as Seedance input (real-person likeness, content_policy_violation). Kept for provenance.

fold_sequence.source: Official Graco marketing image: open -> mid-fold -> folded, same shoot as start/end frames

manual_fold_page.source: Official Graco Ready2Jet manual, page 34: prep steps + thumb switch / handle lever diagrams

similar_fold_clip.source: Condition C only; no rights-cleared clip sourced yet. Leave empty unless running the stretch condition.
